speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: The Ministry of National Development (MND) will continue to ensure that we develop sustainably, build an endearing home and a distinctive global city, and meet the diverse aspirations of Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will update our housing and planning strategies to reflect the concerns and aspirations of our time.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: These strategies will be translated into detailed land use and development plans for the next ten to fifteen years in the upcoming Master Plan review.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: While the construction sector was severely disrupted by the COVID-19 pandemic, we have made good progress to get back on track.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will continue to maintain a steady pipeline to meet housing demand, and adjust our policies as necessary to keep the property market stable and sustainable.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We must continue to update our public housing programmes and policies as our city develops and society matures.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We also have more singles and caregivers in our society, and more young Singaporeans aspire to live independently.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: In addition, our public housing estates and HDB flats are ageing.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: (c)	We will pair housing with proactive social support to uplift lower income families and help them move towards home ownership.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: (d)	We will develop a range of housing options and provide stronger support for singles, seniors, as well as persons with disabilities.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: (e)	We will design and build estates to forge strong communities, bring Singaporeans closer together, and integrate how we live, work and play.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: (f) We will rejuvenate and upgrade existing housing estates to improve the quality of our living environment.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: (g) We will work together with Singaporeans to promote social norms in our neighbourhoods that reflect our values of mutual respect and care for one another.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Ultimately, our new social compact on housing represents a consensus among Singaporeans on our priorities as a nation and how we should allocate finite land and limited resources to meet growing aspirations.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We must also set aside enough land and resources for future generations, to meet their aspirations and needs.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: MND will continue to plan boldly for the long-term, carefully balancing different needs and executing detailed plans to keep our city-state green, vibrant, and inclusive.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will embark on big moves and create more space by transforming the Greater Southern Waterfront and relocating Paya Lebar Airbase so that new and sustainable towns can be built.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will continue to make concerted efforts to retain and weave in our uniquely Singaporean identity as we develop Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We have evolved from a “Garden City” to a “City in a Garden”, and now aspire to be a City in Nature, where native flora and fauna thrive amid a flourishing, urban metropolis.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will secure and extend our natural capital for generations to enjoy, and continue to build a productive and vibrant city, while strengthening the distinctive character and heritage of our towns and neighbourhoods.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will design our districts to connect with our shared memories of the area, which amplifies our Singaporean identity and provides residents with a sense of belonging, ownership, and community.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will plan for a range of possibilities as far ahead as possible, and introduce greater flexibility and optionality in our land use plans, so we can respond nimbly to crises and challenges.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: By carefully pacing out development plans, we can also better respond to changes in land use needs.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: To protect our city from the effects of climate change, we will deploy both infrastructure and nature-based solutions.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: These plans need to be supported by a strong and progressive built environment sector.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: The refreshed Built Environment Industry Transformation Map reflects our resolve to design, construct, and maintain our buildings in a more productive and sustainable manner, while strengthening our resilience against future challenges.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: We will continue to partner Singaporeans to ensure that Singapore remains a distinctive and thriving city, with inclusive neighbourhoods and endearing homes for all Singaporeans.
